name: Adam Devine
bio: Adam Devine (born on November 6, 1983) is an American actor and writer, known for the comedy series Workaholics (2011-2017), which he starred in and co-created. He has also starred in the films Pitch Perfect (2012), its 2015 sequel, The Intern (2015), and Isn’t It Romantic (2019).
